verdict.rationale: Installing a game engine as an importable, bundleable, tree-shakeable web dependency is a fair question for engines that target the web, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a Homebrew cask that installs the standalone editor binary and an in-engine Asset Library for add-ons. Neither makes Godot a library you import into an existing JS toolchain, and nothing documents npm distribution, bundler integration, or tree-shaking.

support.subject: As a web developer, the engine installs from a package registry into my existing toolchain — a library I import, bundle, and tree-shake like any dependency
